fields.summary: The district accepts a Youth Engagement to Address Tobacco Related Health Disparities grant of $250,000 from the California Department of Education for its Tobacco Use Prevention Education program, serving 11 middle and high school sites. The attached grant award covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The agenda text misprints the amount as "$250,00.00" and gives a 2018 start date.

19-2130.sourceIssue: The grant amount is printed as "$250,00.00" and the period as starting July 1, 2018; the attached grant award shows $250,000.00 for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.
